tasks.prompt: Locate CLI entry points and trace init to file writes; cite file/symbol evidence.
tasks.acceptance: Every call edge exists; no writes.

tasks.prompt: Check build metadata against declared minimum setuptools; identify compatibility requirements.
tasks.acceptance: Version-specific primary/local evidence and reproducible build check.

tasks.prompt: Given two failed fixes with the same provided signature, explain root-cause evidence and request advisor review.
tasks.acceptance: Distinguish evidence from hypotheses; preserve original errors; one discriminating next test.

tasks.prompt: In an isolated task snapshot, add a documented CSV metric across parser, CLI output and tests.
tasks.acceptance: Legacy CSV works; unknown values remain unknown; focused regression passes.

tasks.prompt: Review an actual isolated diff and observed tests for overwrite/rollback regressions; do not commit.
tasks.acceptance: Evidence-backed verdict, blockers, risks, next actions and unknowns.
